events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when music videos were a new thing? Today marks the anniversary of MTV's launch, kicking off with an ironically prophetic tune from The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star, or just give it a new lease on life?

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring tracks like "Supersonic" and "Live Forever".

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, bringing "3 Days of Peace & Music" to half a million people in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock. A defining moment for a generation, and still echoing through music history. Which performance would you have loved to see?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock & Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley. His voice, his moves, his legacy – still captivating audiences decades later. Forever the King.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who tragically left us on this day in 1996. A powerful voice whose music continues to resonate and influence generations.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work and electrifying stage presence changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, featuring its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: The album cover that launched a thousand pilgrimages. Today marks the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' release. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the indomitable Chrissie Hynde. A true rock icon, still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't deny his rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon released "Imagine" in the UK
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine UK Release Anniversary
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message that transcends generations. Today marks the UK single release anniversary of John Lennon's 'Imagine'.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: First iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the original iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changing music consumption forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred, and always on time. Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their eclectic, self-titled double LP, forever known as 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds.
